# What's new in 1.3.3

Released **2026-10-10**. Full project history: [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md).

## Highlights

- **Startup splash.** The app icon and “Looking for the trainer…” show while the trainer search holds the first window.
- **Stage cue.** In the last 3 seconds before the next stage, a transparent overlay counts 1, then 2, then 3.

## Installer

- `steadyGrind-1.3.3-macos.dmg` (this folder)
- GitHub Release: https://github.com/attilameget/HomeWlanTrainer/releases/tag/v1.3.3
